scope: Real configured maker/checker, two isolated Chrome tabs, existing loopback/public registrations, no backend seeding, no file, no autonomous grant. Synthetic reviewer approvals are exercised by this harness. Exact user email is preserved as a separate already-saved record.
prompt:
Fill this Customer draft with Company name “genosys”, Contact email “[multisite.mviblhnn@example.test](mailto:multisite.mviblhnn@example.test)”, and Region “Singapore”. Let me review the changes and confirm before saving.
After the Customer is saved, inspect the paired flolah.cloud MCP Universe tab. Share the Customer’s Company name privately with that copilot, without uploading a file.
Ask that copilot to use the shared Company name as its MCP search text. Preserve the current transport selection. Let me review the field change before applying it. Do not click Search, open a provider, navigate away, or submit anything on flolah.cloud.
Wait for the other copilot’s actual result, then summarize what completed on each website. Report any failure specifically; do not repeat a Save.

goal.message: The plan has been revised to incorporate the feedback, removing unnecessary steps and consolidating the peer goal to include all required actions.

steps.title: Share Company name and set MCP search text

steps.expected: All delegated instructions return their recorded recipient outcomes.

steps.title: Summarize outcomes
steps.instruction: Summarize what completed on each website after the operations.
steps.expected: Summary of completed operations on both websites.
